marta: please add rows to the shared action tracker with owner, artifact, acceptance, and ETA. i will chase unassigned items tomorrow.

pager-bot: incident drill reminder: 2026-05-18 7:30-09:00. sign up: https://calendar.company/internal/drills

owen: adding priority_map example here and will PR: primary: rwinf-v4; fallbacks: [rwinf-v3-quant, open-lite]. also will add alert: >20 401s/min for 3m.

lee: cross-check: owen + infra must validate the fallback will not cause cache stampedes. add KV TTL checks to the runbook.

marta: ok everyone, update your tracker rows by EOD Friday or i'll reassign. thanks.
